subject: Re: PO fields, invoice timing, and tiered rebate eligibility
messages:
From: Alicia Barnes <alicia.barnes@medicorp.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@medicorp.com
Date: 2026-09-26T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial PO and invoicing constraints for Medicorp pilot

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team liked the latency profile and the routing options. Procurement asked me to share our PO template and a few constraints so we can make the commercial paperwork straightforward. Key asks from finance/procurement: 

- PO must include a distinct purchase_order_id field (we use the PO to drive AR automation).
- Net terms: standard request is Net60 for pilot-stage vendors.
- Invoice cadence: preferred monthly statements, but we have one carveout — if there are milestone/usage spikes we can accept interim invoices, provided they are tied to PO line item references.
- Discounting: eligibility for volume rebates requires PO-level commitment and a quarterly reconciliation schedule.

Attaching our PO (stub) and the procurement checklist. Can Redwood accept a Net60 invoice cadence and include the PO id on every invoice PDF? Also — does Redwood support issuing a partial invoice for usage above a committed baseline mid-cycle?

Attachments: [Attachment: Medicorp_PO_78934.pdf (application/pdf, 48KB)]

Best,
Alicia Barnes
Sr. Procurement Manager
Medicorp Health

---
From: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
To: Alicia Barnes <alicia.barnes@medicorp.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-28T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial PO and invoicing constraints for Medicorp pilot

Hi Alicia — thanks for the PO and the clear checklist. Looping in Vanessa (commercial ops) and Ben (billing) so we can confirm internal approvals and the billing format. Quick responses to your bullets below: 

- PO id on invoice: yes — our invoice generator can include a purchase_order_id field in the invoice header and embed the PO id in the filename (we'll include PO metadata in the PDF microformat).

- Net60: we can accept Net60 for the pilot, but finance requires a written approval for Net60 combined with a rebate schedule; otherwise our standard is Net30 (we typically push Net60 for enterprise commitments). I will flag this as an approval we need from revenue ops.

- Interim/partial invoices: supported. We can issue interim invoices tied to PO line items or usage thresholds. We do ask that interim invoices reference the PO id and the committed baseline so our AR matches correctly.

- Discount/rebate reconciliation: we support quarterly reconciliation and can generate consumption reports per PO line item to feed into the rebate calculation. Two questions for you: 1) does Medicorp require invoices to be batched into a single monthly statement per legal entity, or can we deliver multiple line-item invoices within the same month? 2) any specific remit-to or GL code requirements we should map in the invoice PDF?

Proposed next steps: Vanessa — can you confirm what exceptions we can approve for Net60 on a pilot? Ben — please confirm the filename/metadata template for embedding PO id and whether we can tag invoices with GL codes. Alicia — once we have those pieces, we can draft a short mutual action plan and send the PO + invoice template for your AP team.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood-Invoice-Rhythm-Options.pdf (application/pdf, 36KB)]

---
From: Alicia Barnes <alicia.barnes@medicorp.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@medicorp.com
Date: 2026-09-29T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial PO and invoicing constraints for Medicorp pilot

Kimberly — appreciate the fast turnaround. Answers inline below: 

- Monthly statement batching: Medicorp prefers a single monthly statement per legal entity for our ERP, but we can accept multiple invoices so long as you include the PO id and a statement reference number that aggregates those invoices into the monthly statement.

- GL codes: yes — AP wants an optional GL code field but it can be supplied as a mapped metadata tag; the PDF doesn't need to display it prominently as long as it's embedded in the invoice metadata or the line item memo.

One more detail: for rebate eligibility, procurement requires that the PO capture an anticipated quarterly spend band (e.g., $100k–$250k). The rebate tiers are triggered at quarter-end reconciliation against the committed band. For the pilot we'll list a conservative commitment.

We attached a redlined PO sample (see attachment) — we'd like Redwood to accept partial interim invoicing for overage, and confirm that a final reconciliation invoice can be issued post-quarter to settle rebates or credits.

Attachments: [Attachment: Medicorp_PO_78934-redline.pdf (application/pdf, 22KB)]

Thanks,
Alicia
---
From: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
To: Alicia Barnes <alicia.barnes@medicorp.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-01T15:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial PO and invoicing constraints for Medicorp pilot

Alicia — thanks, that all sounds workable. Internal decision notes below (kept concise for AP):

- Net terms: Vanessa has confirmed we can approve Net60 for this pilot under a one-quarter credit holdback: Redwood will accept Net60 provided Medicorp signs the PO with the committed quarterly band and agrees to a single reconciliation invoice at quarter close. This mitigates cash exposure while honoring your Net60 request.

- Invoice batching and statements: Ben confirms we will emit a single monthly statement per legal entity (statement_ref in the invoice metadata). We will also provide the option to issue interim invoices for overage; interim invoices will include the PO id and a statement_ref so your ERP can reconcile them into the monthly statement.

- GL code support: Ben notes GL code can be supplied as an invoice metadata tag (field name: gl_code). We'll include an example mapping in the invoice template.

- Rebate mechanics: Redwood will accept the committed quarterly band on the PO as the trigger. At quarter close we will generate a reconciliation invoice/credit memo tied to the same PO id. Any rebate payable to Medicorp will be shown as a credit line on the reconciliation invoice.

Next steps (action items):
1) Kimberly: draft a two-page MOU (PO handling + invoice cadence + Net60 exception + reconciliation mechanics).
2) Vanessa: prepare internal approval note for Net60 exception and credit holdback.
3) Ben: attach final invoice template examples with metadata mapping.
4) Alicia: sign the attached PO redline and return; we'll follow with the MOU and DocuSign link.

We'll attach the invoice template and a proposed MOU in the next hour. If you're able to sign the redline this week we can start billing under the pilot in October.

Best regards,
Kimberly Park
Head of Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
